action.action-desc: Mr. Correa (for himself, Mr. Fitzpatrick, Ms. Houlahan, Mr. García of Illinois, Mr. Carbajal, and Mr. Soto) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Ways and Means

form.official-title: To amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to establish a credit for amounts paid or incurred by child care providers to advance innovation and access for developmentally disabled individuals.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Bright Beginnings Act.

section.header: Establishment of child care innovation and access credit

subsection.text: Subpart D of part IV of subchapter A of chapter 1 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 is amended by adding at the end the following new section:

section.header: Child care innovation and access credit

subsection.text: For purposes of section 38, in the case of an eligible child care provider, the child care innovation and access credit determined under this section for any taxable year is an amount equal to so much of the eligible expenditures of the taxpayer for such taxable year as does not exceed $10,000.
For purposes of this section, the term eligible child care provider means a center-based provider of child care services that—

subparagraph.text: for fewer than 24 hours per day, and
to individuals who have not attained the age of 14, and

paragraph.text: is legally operating under State law and complies with applicable State and local requirements for the provision of such services.

The term eligible expenditures means, with respect to any eligible child care provider, any amounts paid or incurred by such provider to advance innovation and access for individuals with developmental disabilities receiving child care services from such provider.
The term innovation means the intentional design and implementation of flexible and responsive environments, tools, and practices that—

subparagraph.text: reflect the full diversity of human development, sensory processing, and learning styles, and

paragraph.text: The term access means the set of physical, sensory, communicative, social, and structural conditions that enable an individual to engage and participate in an environment in ways that align with their modes of interaction.

subparagraph.text: any diagnosed cognitive, physical, communicative, social, emotional, or adaptive developmental delay, and
any diagnosed condition likely to result in a developmental delay described in subparagraph (A).

All members of the same controlled group of corporations (within the meaning of section 52(a)) and all persons under common control (within the meaning of section 52(b)) shall be treated as 1 person for purposes of this section.
The Secretary shall apportion the dollar limitation under subsection (a) among the members of any group described in subparagraph (A) in such manner as the Secretary shall by regulations prescribe.

paragraph.text: No deduction or credit shall be allowed under this chapter for any amount taken into account in determining the credit under this section.

subsection.text: The Secretary shall prescribe such regulations or other guidance as may be necessary or appropriate to carry out the purposes of this section.
This section shall not apply to any amount paid or incurred after December 31, 2031.

subsection.header: Credit made part of general business credit
subsection.text: Section 38(b) of such Code is amended by striking plus at the end of paragraph (40), by striking the period at the end of paragraph (41) and inserting , plus, and by adding at the end the following new paragraph:

paragraph.text: in the case of an eligible child care provider (as defined in section 45BB(b)), the child care innovation and access credit determined under section 45BB(a).

subsection.text: Section 6417(b) of such Code is amended by redesignating paragraphs (10) through (12) as paragraphs (11) through (13), respectively, and by inserting after paragraph (9) the following new paragraph:

paragraph.text: The child care innovation and access credit determined under section 45BB(a).

subsection.text: The table of sections for subpart D of part IV of subchapter A of chapter 1 of such Code is amended by adding after the item relating to section 45AA the following new item:

toc.toc-entry: Sec. 45BB. Child care innovation and access credit.

subsection.text: The amendments made by this section shall apply to amounts paid or incurred after December 31, 2026.
